passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Twitch Camouflages and gains % Move Speed for seconds. The Move Speed increases to % while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains % Attack Speed for seconds. When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.description: Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for seconds. Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by % and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Contaminate
spells.description: Deals physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional physical damage and magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom. Max Damage: physical damage and magical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation PhysicalDamagePerStack was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.description: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining Attack Range and Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal % less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of % damage.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
